description: Pass run_id to get one test run's detail plus its result summary (instance counts by status — passed / failed / skipped / not started / in progress — and pass rate). Otherwise pass project_id to list runs with optional filters. Every returned run carries run_type ("kaneai" or "manual") identifying KaneAI runs — the backend stores KaneAI runs with type "Manual" (result-entry mode), so use run_type, not type, to tell them apart.

project_id.description: Project ID (ULID). Required when run_id is not given.

run_id.description: Test run ID (ULID). When given, returns detail + result summary.

run_type.description: Filter: "kaneai" (KaneAI runs), "manual" (human result-entry runs, KaneAI excluded), or "automation" (framework-uploaded runs). Buckets are disjoint.

status.description: Filter: Not Started, In Progress, Passed, Failed, Skipped

name: tm_get_test_runs
title: Get Test Runs
